title: Fixing Stuck Kueue Workload
description: Last-resort kick for a Kueue workload stuck in QuotaReserved/Requeued: deactivate/activate it, only after confirming it has 0 pods left (none Terminating). Not for workloads with stuck Terminating pods (use kueue-stuck-termination-recovery).

step_notes.deactivate-and-activate-kueue-workload: Evicts and immediately re-admits the workload. Check its preconditions first (stuck admission, Kueue version without the fix, 0 pods left, no FailedKillPod events). See [[gotchas-kubernetes-gke]] gotcha 6.
